purpose: R04 frozen target-protection ROI in the sensing CIR tap domain. The ROI and reference amplitude are fixed on the CALIBRATION set only and must never be re-searched on SIC results. One CIR tap equals one work sample (998.4 MS/s).
method: For each calibration seed, take the clean (s+w) consumer raw complex CIR (the SIC consumer's `__c32` payload, before any L2 normalization). The weak sensing path is delay 37 work samples with gain 0.25 on top of the delay-0 unit path; the frozen ROI is placed around the weak-target local peak, far from the main lobe. target_tap = argmax |c_raw| within the ROI of the calibration median CIR. target_ref_amp = median over the calibration windows of |c_raw[target_tap]|.

calibration.note: Seeds 1000000-1000099 are the frozen calibration list (testdata/sic_preamble/cases/main.json). The SIC-acceptance seed list (2000000+) is disjoint. The ROI is not re-derived from any SIC result.
